scope: Verified-input Tier 2 systemic and hunch analysis of Salus as a non-GEO DHS procurement control

finding_gate.prior_synthesis_action: No correction, supersession, or new finding. The replacement set sharpens provenance and analytic boundaries without changing the bounded verdict.

semantic_boundaries: Salus is a non-GEO control; no Salus finding is scored against GEO-specific competition groups 335/336 or 337/338.
A non-GEO policy-responsive procurement path is an existence proof, not a department-wide base rate or explanation of GEO selection.
The OCI waiver documents agency risk treatment; it proves neither an actual conflict nor the absence of one.
The court observation concerning bad faith was administrative-record bounded and is not an exoneration.
GAO outcome-predictive ADR followed by withdrawal is not a GAO merits decision.
Article III standing, statutory standing, interested-party status, prejudice, and alternative merits discussion remain distinct.
The $1,409,688 evaluated scenario price is not the $915 million maximum, obligation, outlay, payment, profit, or revenue.
Finding 12975 is a bounded public/redacted no-bridge result, not proof of universal absence.
Congressional allegations and Salus responses are party or oversight positions, not adjudicated facts.
Zero structured subaward rows do not prove no subcontractors, CTAs, vendors, affiliates, or other partners.

database_integrity.note: Established pre-existing baseline and unchanged after completing runs 111 and 112; this analysis created no finding, hypothesis, lead, tag, connection, or assessment rows.
